action_instruction: Checking status visibility on displayed rows
intent: whether every displayed row in the Posts list shows a status control with a status value

action_params.query: whether every displayed row in the Posts list shows a status control with a status value
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(30).children).every(row => { const status = row.querySelector('[role="combobox"]'); return !!status && !!(status.offsetWidth || status.offsetHeight || status.getClientRects().length) && status.textContent.trim().length > 0; })

action_instruction: Checking vote-count visibility on displayed rows
intent: whether every displayed row in the Posts list shows a numeric vote count

action_params.condition: Every displayed row shows vote count.
action_params.query: whether every displayed row in the Posts list shows a numeric vote count
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(30).children).every(row => { const vote = Array.from(row.children).find(child => child.tagName === 'SPAN' && child.classList.contains('inline-flex') && /^\d+$/.test(child.textContent.trim())); return !!vote && !!(vote.offsetWidth || vote.offsetHeight || vote.getClientRects().length); })

action_instruction: Checking age visibility on displayed rows

action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(30).children).every(row => { const age = Array.from(row.children).find(child => child.tagName === 'SPAN' && /\bago\b/.test(child.textContent)); return !!age && !!(age.offsetWidth || age.offsetHeight || age.getClientRects().length) && age.textContent.trim().length > 0; })
